selected.seed_rule: Keep main seed unless paired development CI supports another
selected.ppo_rule: Select short-run periodic-best as PPO alternative: highest128-wall development point estimate among saved PPO candidates, also earlier; no statistically supported gain over BC, so recommend BC.

confirmatory.method: paired wall bootstrap; three prespecified contrasts; Bonferroni percentile intervals are approximate

seed_stability.method: two-level paired bootstrap: resample training-seed pairs and common walls; only 3 seeds limits population inference

seed_stability_legacy.method: two-level paired bootstrap: resample training-seed pairs and common walls; only 3 seeds limits population inference

supplementary_confirmation.method: One separately registered follow-up contrast, new500-wall population;20k paired wall bootstrap; original final pool is exploratory for this late-snapshot selection.
